hero.kicker: The better way to live together
hero.desc: One place for meals, expenses, payments, roommates — and everything that keeps a shared home running smoothly.

statement.dim: — the bazar, the bills, the dinner count and the person who still owes for the gas.

fair.title: Fair by design
fair.text: Meal rates and shared bills split to the paisa. Nobody does the math on a napkin again.

honest.title: Honest money
honest.text: Every payment and charge lands on a ledger. Mistakes are reversed, never quietly edited.

roles.title: Roles with respect
roles.text: Admins, managers and meal managers see what they need — members see what's theirs.

features.lead: Six tools that talk to each other — so a meal-off request updates the meal rate, and the meal rate updates everyone's balance.

home.title: Run one home, or five.
home.text: Separate books, members and chat for every place you live. Invite with a link or an 8-character code.

meal.title: The meal rate does itself.
meal.text: Breakfast, lunch and dinner per person, guest meals and meal-offs — with a fair rate that updates live.

chat.title: A group chat that knows the house.
chat.text: Private chat for every home, plus direct messages with friends. Typing, read receipts and who's online.
chat.msg2: Yes please. I'll get the beef.

pay.title: Know who paid. Instantly.
pay.text: Members submit bKash or cash payments; managers confirm with one tap.

s1.title: Create your home
s1.text: Name it, set house rules, meal types and the notice period. Two minutes, tops.

s2.title: Invite your roommates
s2.text: Share a link or your home code. They read the rules, accept, and they're in.

s3.title: Manage everything together
s3.text: Meals, bazar, rent and dues stay in sync — and everyone can see their own numbers.

fin.lead: Bazar, rent, bills and deposits all land on each member's account — so the balance is never an argument.
fin.check1: Split bills equally, between chosen members, or from the home fund
fin.check2: Members submit payments; managers confirm in one tap
fin.check3: Positive balance means advance, negative means dues — always visible
fin.check4: Corrections are reversals with a reason, never silent edits

off.title: Meal-off before the deadline
off.text: Members request a day off before cut-off; the meal manager approves and the list updates itself.

guest.title: Guests without awkwardness
guest.text: Bring a cousin for dinner — guest meals are counted and charged to the right person.

bazar.title: Bazar becomes the meal rate
bazar.text: Grocery expenses feed the meal pool. Close the month and everyone's share posts automatically.

chat.lead: Every home gets its own private chat — only current members can read it. And friend chats stay separate, so you can message people across homes.
chat.m1: Water's off Friday 10–4. Store some tonight 💧
chat.f1: Is there a room free in your mess next month?
chat.f2: Tanvir leaves on the 30th — I'll send you an invite link 🙌

cta.text: Free to start. Bring your roommates in with a single link.

footer.tagline: The calm way to run a shared home — meals, money, people and conversations in one place.
